statement: For every pair of integers p,q >= 1, let T(p,0,0,q) be the caterpillar with four spine vertices and respectively p,0,0,q attached leaves. The full coefficient sequence of its domination polynomial D_{T(p,0,0,q)}(x) is log-concave: d_j^2 >= d_{j-1}d_{j+1} for every 1 <= j <= p+q+3.
contribution: An exact proof of the natural two-parameter, length-two internal-zero subfamily not covered by Du--Heilman--Panova Theorem 3.3. The proof derives the domination polynomial by endpoint states, reverses it into nested binomial convolutions with three sparse perturbations, and certifies all ten affected minors coefficientwise. This is a proper partial result only: it neither settles arbitrary zero blocks nor claims priority beyond the bounded current literature search.
